source_caption:
🎬 Breaking Away (1979)

Breaking Away follows Dave Stohler, a young man from Bloomington, Indiana, who dreams of becoming a professional cyclist after graduating from high school. Obsessed with Italian cycling culture, Dave spends his days training, pretending to be Italian, and imagining a life beyond his small hometown. Alongside his three best friends, Mike, Cyril, and Moocher, he struggles with growing up, finding direction, and dealing with the divide between local working-class teenagers and wealthy university students. When a major bicycle race offers Dave the opportunity to prove himself, he discovers important lessons about friendship, determination, family, and believing in his dreams. Filled with humor, heartfelt moments, and inspiring competition, Breaking Away celebrates ambition, loyalty, and the journey toward adulthood.

🎭 Genre: Comedy • Drama • Sports • Coming-of-Age

⭐ IMDb: 7.7/10

⏱️ Runtime: 1h 41m • PG

🎥 Director: Peter Yates

✍️ Writer: Steve Tesich

🏆 Awards: Academy Award winner for Best Original Screenplay.
